SQLQueries.GetLastPunchTracking: SELECT TOP 1 Id, TenantId, EmployeeId, PunchId, PunchDate, Direction, CASE WHEN PunchIn IS NOT NULL THEN DATEADD(SECOND, DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), PunchIn), CAST(PunchDate AS DATETIME)) END AS PunchIn, CASE WHEN PunchOut IS NOT NULL THEN DATEADD(SECOND, DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), PunchOut), CAST(PunchDate AS DATETIME)) END AS PunchOut, CASE WHEN Duration IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), Duration) AS FLOAT) / 60.0 END AS Duration, InsertDate, InsertUserId, UpdateDate, UpdateUserId, InSource, OutSource, CoordinateIn, CoordinateOut, LinkIn, LinkOut, ImageUrl, Manual, PunchOutReason FROM PunchTracking WHERE EmployeeId = @EmployeeId AND TenantId = @TenantId AND PunchDate = @PunchDate ORDER BY Id DESC

SQLQueries.GetLastUnmatchedPunchIn: SELECT TOP 1 Id, TenantId, EmployeeId, PunchId, PunchDate, Direction, CASE WHEN PunchIn IS NOT NULL THEN DATEADD(SECOND, DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), PunchIn), CAST(PunchDate AS DATETIME)) END AS PunchIn, CASE WHEN PunchOut IS NOT NULL THEN DATEADD(SECOND, DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), PunchOut), CAST(PunchDate AS DATETIME)) END AS PunchOut, CASE WHEN Duration IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), Duration) AS FLOAT) / 60.0 END AS Duration, InsertDate, InsertUserId, UpdateDate, UpdateUserId, InSource, OutSource, CoordinateIn, CoordinateOut, LinkIn, LinkOut, ImageUrl, Manual, PunchOutReason FROM PunchTracking WHERE PunchId = @PunchId AND Direction = 'IN' AND Id > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(Id) FROM PunchTracking WHERE PunchId = @PunchId AND Direction = 'OUT'), 0) ORDER BY Id DESC
SQLQueries.GetPunchTrackingTimeline: SELECT pt.Id, pt.PunchId, pt.EmployeeId, e.Name AS EmployeeName, pt.PunchDate, pt.Direction, CASE WHEN pt.PunchIn IS NOT NULL THEN DATEADD(SECOND, DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), pt.PunchIn), CAST(pt.PunchDate AS DATETIME)) END AS PunchIn, CASE WHEN pt.PunchOut IS NOT NULL THEN DATEADD(SECOND, DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), pt.PunchOut), CAST(pt.PunchDate AS DATETIME)) END AS PunchOut, CASE WHEN pt.Direction = 'IN' THEN DATEADD(SECOND, DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), pt.PunchIn), CAST(pt.PunchDate AS DATETIME)) ELSE DATEADD(SECOND, DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), pt.PunchOut), CAST(pt.PunchDate AS DATETIME)) END AS PunchTime, CASE WHEN pt.Direction = 'IN' THEN pt.InSource ELSE pt.OutSource END AS Source, CASE WHEN pt.Direction = 'IN' THEN pt.CoordinateIn ELSE pt.CoordinateOut END AS Coordinate, CASE WHEN pt.Direction = 'IN' THEN pt.LinkIn ELSE pt.LinkOut END AS Address, pt.ImageUrl, pt.Manual, pt.PunchOutReason AS Remarks FROM PunchTracking pt INNER JOIN Employee e ON e.Id = pt.EmployeeId WHERE pt.PunchId = @PunchId AND pt.EmployeeId = @EmployeeId AND pt.TenantId = @TenantId ORDER BY CASE WHEN pt.Direction = 'IN' THEN pt.PunchIn ELSE pt.PunchOut END ASC
